description: Resolve a job title, a company's internal name for a role, a nickname or a degree name to a canonical VOLO entity. Call this FIRST whenever a person names their job. It matches names; it does not read sentences — so work out yourself which job the person means and pass only that title, in the singular ("taxi driver", not "Will robotaxis replace taxi drivers?"). Returns a match field of exact or approximate — when it is approximate, say which entity you read the question as. Null means this name did not match, not yet that VOLO lacks the job: before saying VOLO does not cover it, call describe_coverage and read its list of covered occupations and degrees — if one of them is what the person means (a synonym, a broader or narrower name), use that one and say which you chose. Only if none fits is it a gap in this site, which is not a statement about the job.
name: resolve_occupation_or_major
